assumptions: A blank ADMIN_TOKEN (empty or whitespace only) is treated as unset (adminToken undefined, admin answers 503) rather than a startup error — so a copied .env.example does not block the storefront.
Login check order is 400 (body not JSON / token not a string) → 503 (not configured) → 401 (mismatch); the 400 follows the api-routes rule and has its own scenario.
PUT /api/admin/settings uses a strict schema: any extra key (e.g. visibility) answers 400, which is how the owner's 'anything else → 400' was read.

An admin-settings.json that exists but fails the schema throws (startup fails fast; the admin and the catalog answer 500 until a human fixes it), following the basket-store precedent instead of silently resetting the admin's choices.

The catalog service reads the settings store on every load (no in-memory cache) for visibility; the data source stays in the service (seeded from the persisted settings at startup, switched by setSource from the admin update) so the archived 'Runtime switch to snapshot' scenario holds unchanged.

Internal signature changes: CatalogService gains loadAll(), createCatalogService gains a required settings option, createApp gains required settingsStore and adminToken — five existing test files get setup-only edits, including add-basket's apps/api/src/routes/basket.test.ts (a code file already on disk; add-basket's openspec artifacts were not touched).
After a successful data-source switch the admin page re-fetches getAdminProducts() (live and snapshot lists differ); the scenario asserts the second call.

Extra UI states recorded without scenarios: 'Завантажуємо…' (role=status) while checking the session / loading the panel, 'Не вдалося увійти' for a login failure that is neither 401 nor 503, 'Не вдалося зберегти' (role=alert) for a failed radio/checkbox mutation, 'Не вдалося завантажити адмін-панель' for a failed panel load.
The per-shop status note ('наживо' / 'знімок' / 'збережена копія' / 'недоступний') is plain text, not role=status, so 'Збережено' is the only live region in the panel.
The body classes bg-white text-stone-900 go on <body> in apps/web/index.html; the light-scheme scenario is asserted by reading index.css and index.html as text (jsdom cannot see them).
The three new GET /api/products scenarios go into a new file apps/api/src/routes/products-visibility.test.ts so add-catalog's products.test.ts stays green during the red run.

The exact cookie headers and HMAC literals (admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; logout admin_session=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax) and the guard path matching (use('/x/*') also matches '/x') were verified against the installed hono 4.13.13 with a throwaway app.request() script in the scratchpad, not via Context7 (consistent with row 4 of docs/context7-log.md); no new row was added to that log.

add-basket is mid-apply (its group 1 red tests are on disk, implementation not yet); add-admin builds on add-basket's design.md decisions as the contract and task 1.1 is a Grep precondition that stops if add-basket has not landed.

The client's request helper from add-basket is generalised to request<T>(method, path, { schema?, body? }) and throws ApiError (an Error with status, same message format), so add-basket's client tests stay green; getProducts is left untouched.

ADDED requirement text in the catalog-api MODIFIED block names the function signatures (selectVisibleProducts, ShopVisibility) because the existing archived requirement already does; the header text 'Visible products are the first ten per shop' was kept exactly, no RENAMED entry.

findings.issue: Five normative SHALL behaviours have no scenario, so under the project's one-test-per-scenario rule they would be implemented untested, and they also go beyond the owner's requirement list: (a) line 13 — the pending state renders role="status" "Завантажуємо…" and nothing else; (b) line 45 — any non-401/503 login failure shows "Не вдалося увійти"; (c) line 45 — "The alert disappears on the next submit"; (d) lines 77-78 — a rejected updateSettings shows "Не вдалося зберегти" (role="alert") and leaves the radios; (e) lines 98-99 — a rejected setProductVisibility shows "Не вдалося зберегти" and leaves the checkbox. design.md D10 itself marks (b), (d), (e) as assumptions. No existing scenario asserts any of these strings or states.
findings.fix: Either add one scenario per behaviour with concrete values, e.g. — "Loading state": getAdminSession() returns an unsettled promise, getBasket() resolves with the empty basket, route /admin rendered → an element with role="status" shows "Завантажуємо…", no heading "Вхід для адміністратора" and no heading "Адмін-панель"; — "Login failure other than 401/503 and alert reset": adminLogin rejects once with Object.assign(new Error("POST /api/admin/login failed: 500"), { status: 500 }) and resolves undefined on the second call, user types secret-token and clicks "Увійти" twice → after the first click role="alert" shows "Не вдалося увійти"; after the second no role="alert" element is rendered and heading "Адмін-панель" is shown; — "Save failure keeps the checkbox": panel as in "Authenticated shows the panel", setProductVisibility rejects with Object.assign(new Error("PUT /api/admin/products/karashynyard:1498486363994/visibility failed: 500"), { status: 500 }), user clicks "Філе індички, 1 кг" → role="alert" shows "Не вдалося зберегти", that checkbox is still checked, region "Карашин Яр" still shows "Видимих: 2"; — "Source switch failure keeps the radio": updateSettings rejects with Object.assign(new Error("PUT /api/admin/settings failed: 500"), { status: 500 }), user clicks "Знімок" → role="alert" shows "Не вдалося зберегти", "Наживо" is still checked, getAdminProducts was called once. Then bump tasks.md 1.9 (10 → 14 tests) and design.md's "46 new scenarios → 46 tests". Or, if the owner does not want these behaviours specified, delete the five sentences from the SHALL text and keep them only as design.md assumptions.

findings.issue: Lines 27-30 ("Authenticated shows the panel") and 63-66 ("Successful login opens the panel"): getAdminSettings() resolves with visibility { karashynyard: null, osio: null } while the four-product response flags karashynyard:1743423686258 as visible: false in a 3-product shop — impossible under the server rule (null → first ten visible), so the fixture cannot be produced by the API and the "Unticking"/"Ticking" toggle answers (visibility arrays of 1 and 3 ids) are inconsistent with a null starting state. The page ignores the array, so the tests still pass, but the fixture misleads a reader checking it against admin-settings.
findings.fix: In both scenarios make getAdminSettings() resolve with { dataSource: <as now>, visibility: { karashynyard: ["karashynyard:1498486363994", "karashynyard:1651059869009"], osio: null } } — with that starting array the toggle answers in "Unticking hides a product" (["karashynyard:1651059869009"]) and "Ticking shows a product" (the 3-id array) become exactly what the server would return.

findings.issue: The main spec's "Data source mode" requirement (openspec/specs/catalog-api/spec.md lines 29-31) still says "The initial mode comes from DATA_SOURCE", which admin-settings' "Persisted data source overrides the environment at startup" now contradicts; after archive the two specs disagree and nothing in this delta amends it.
findings.fix: Add a second MODIFIED block "### Requirement: Data source mode" to this delta that repeats its three scenarios verbatim ("Config reads DATA_SOURCE", "Snapshot mode serves the committed files", "Runtime switch to snapshot") and changes the sentence to: "The initial mode is the persisted admin `dataSource` when `<dataDir>/admin-settings.json` exists, otherwise `DATA_SOURCE` (default `live`, read only in `apps/api/src/config.ts`); it can be changed at runtime through `setSource`."

findings.issue: Lines 55-64 ("Persisted data source overrides DATA_SOURCE"): the WHEN never names the snapshot directory although the THEN (`status: "snapshot"`, `count: 10` per shop) only holds over `data/shops/`; and the second WHEN says "the same store is created over an empty temp directory", which is ambiguous (same instance vs. same defaults). tasks.md 1.5 fills both in, but the scenario should stand alone.
findings.fix: Write "a catalog with fake adapters over `data/shops/` is created with `source: settings.dataSource` and that store as its `settings`" and "WHEN a store with the same defaults is created on `<tmp2>/admin-settings.json` (`<tmp2>` a fresh empty temp directory)".

findings.issue: Lines 215-219 ("Malformed id or body"): only the first WHEN says "with a valid session cookie"; the second and third WHENs just say "is requested". Sent without the cookie they answer 401 { error: "Unauthorized" } (guard runs before parsing), not the 400 the THEN expects.
findings.fix: Append "with the same cookie" to the second and third WHEN lines (as "Invalid settings body" does with "it is requested" after an explicit cookie).

findings.issue: Risks / Trade-offs, last bullet: "the route file holds 21 tests" — tasks.md 1.6 lists twenty-two (10 admin-auth route scenarios + 12 admin-settings route scenarios = 22).

D9 (and task 6.1) types the generalised helper as `request<T>(method, path, { schema?: ZodType<T>; body? })`, which needs `import type { ZodType } from "zod"` in apps/web/src/api/client.ts. `zod` is a dependency of packages/shared only; under pnpm's isolated layout there is no node_modules/zod anywhere on the walk-up path from apps/web (verified: tsc with the web tsconfig options reports TS2307 "Cannot find module 'zod'"). `pnpm test` stays green because the type import is erased, but `pnpm typecheck` and therefore task 7.2 `pnpm check` go red; adding zod to apps/web contradicts proposal.md "Dependencies: none added" and AGENTS.md "ask before adding a dependency".
findings.fix: In D9 and task 6.1 type the option structurally — `schema?: { parse(input: unknown): T }` (every zod schema satisfies it, no import) — or add `export type { ZodType } from "zod"` to packages/shared/src/index.ts (task 2.1) and import it from `@organic/shared`. Say which in D9 so the loop agent does not reach for `pnpm add zod`.

findings.issue: Requirement "Admin functions of the API client" / D9 interpolate the raw id (`/api/admin/products/${id}/visibility`) and the scenario "Admin requests send method, path and body" pins `"/api/admin/products/osio:6abcf192b7db2532803d266d/visibility"`. The add-basket code review (docs/reviews/2026-10-04-add-basket-code-reviewer.md, finding 5) rejected exactly this in the same helper's callers because ProductIdSchema permits `#`, `?`, `%` (failing input `osio:a#b` → the server sees `osio:a` → 404); the owner accepted it, and add-basket's basket-web spec now says "The productId in a path SHALL be encodeURIComponent-encoded" (scenario "Product id is URL-encoded in the path", task 8.3). The admin client repeats the defect, and its pinned unencoded path contradicts the rule the shared helper's other callers now follow.
findings.fix: In D9: `setProductVisibility = (id, visible) => request("PUT", `/api/admin/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/visibility`, …)`; in the scenario and in task 1.7 change the expected fetch path to `/api/admin/products/osio%3A6abcf192b7db2532803d266d/visibility`. The admin-settings API scenarios need no change: Hono decodes `:id`, so `app.request()` with the raw id and a browser request with `%3A` reach the same handler value.

findings.issue: File layout and tasks 5.1, 5.2, 6.3 ship apps/api/src/lib/admin-auth.ts and lib/admin.ts "covered by the route tests" and AdminLoginForm.tsx / AdminPanel.tsx / AdminShopSection.tsx "covered by AdminPage tests", with no test beside any of them. AGENTS.md ("Logic in src/lib/ has no Hono import and a Vitest test beside it"; definition of done "a test next to the code") and .claude/rules/web.md ("A component with a user-visible behaviour has a Testing Library test beside it") require them, and the project's reviewers enforced this on both previous changes (add-catalog group 10 `cache.test.ts`; add-basket code-reviewer finding 7 → task 8.4 `lib/basket.test.ts`, `BasketLine.test.tsx`). The plan knowingly repeats a pattern that costs a FIX FIRST verdict and an extra loop iteration against a 5-iteration budget.
findings.fix: Add to group 1 (red run) and to the File layout: apps/api/src/lib/admin.test.ts (listProducts flags and total/visible over a stub `loadAll` + temp settings store; setProductVisibility first-toggle default array, append, remove, idempotent repeat, not-found writes nothing), apps/api/src/lib/admin-auth.test.ts (the three `login` results), apps/web/src/components/AdminShopSection.test.tsx (four status notes, "Видимих: N", no `<ul>` when empty, checkbox change callback) and AdminLoginForm.test.tsx (submit passes the typed token, alert text per status). Keep the route/page tests as the scenario tests; the unit tests assert the same scenario values.

findings.issue: D7 claims the guard is "bound to paths rather than registration order, so a later route cannot slip in front of it". Verified against the installed Hono 4.13.13 through app.request(): a `routes.get("/settings")` registered before `routes.use("/settings/*", guard)` answers 200 with no cookie — matched handlers run in registration order. The prescribed layout (both `use` lines before the guarded handlers) is correct; the rationale is false and would mislead an implementer who reorders the file.
findings.fix: Replace the sentence with: "register both `use` lines before any guarded handler — Hono runs matched handlers in registration order, so a handler added above the guard would bypass it (the scenario 'Missing cookie is unauthorized' catches that)."

findings.issue: Stale or inconsistent facts: (a) design D2 says `.env.example` ships `ADMIN_TOKEN=` — it ships `ADMIN_TOKEN=change-me`, so a copied `.env` has the admin configured with that token; the smoke-run text ("sets ADMIN_TOKEN in .env") should say to replace it. (b) design Risks say "the route file holds 21 tests" while task 1.6 names twenty-two (the correct count). (c) D3 justifies fail-loud on a bad settings file by "the basket-store precedent", which add-basket task 8.2 is replacing with per-record tolerance; the decision still fits a one-object file but the citation will be wrong. (d) Precondition 1.1 and the setup-edit list in 5.4 predate add-basket group 8: after 8.3/8.4 land, client.ts carries `encodeURIComponent` that the 6.1 helper rewrite must keep, and the new apps/api/src/lib/basket.test.ts / apps/web/src/components/BasketLine.test.tsx may build a catalog fake typed as `CatalogService` that needs the same `loadAll` setup edit as routes/basket.test.ts.
findings.fix: (a) D2: state `ADMIN_TOKEN=change-me` and tell the human to replace it in the smoke run. (b) Risks: "22 tests". (c) D3: drop the precedent clause, keep "a corrupt one-object settings file fails loudly". (d) Task 1.1: also Grep for fakes typed `CatalogService` / `ReturnType<typeof createCatalogService>` under apps/** and list every hit in 5.4; task 6.1: "keep add-basket's `encodeURIComponent(productId)` in the basket paths".

Scenario headings across the five delta specs: 52, of which 1 is the repeated existing scenario of the MODIFIED catalog-api requirement, so 51 new scenarios (admin-web 17, admin-auth 11, admin-settings 17, catalog-api 4 new + 1 repeated, catalog-web 2). tasks.md: 26 "- [ ]" checkboxes, last one "Run pnpm check and quote its summary lines".
assumptions: Finding 1 applied with the critique's first option (add scenarios), not the deletion option: the five behaviours are needed for a usable page (something must render while the session resolves; a silent failed save is exactly the defect class add-basket's code review returned as FIX FIRST and the owner then accepted as the 'Removing a line fails' scenario), and the owner's requirement list does not forbid them. Four scenarios were added to specs/admin-web/spec.md: 'Loading state', 'Login failure other than 401/503 and alert reset' (adminLogin rejects with status 500 once, resolves on the second click; alert gone and panel shown), 'Source switch failure keeps the radio', 'Save failure keeps the checkbox'. The SHALL wording for the alert reset was made testable ('a submit removes the previous alert before adminLogin is called'). design.md D10 no longer marks these as assumptions; it names the scenarios.

The page's 'failed' state (role=status 'Не вдалося завантажити адмін-панель') is not a SHALL in the spec and was not in the finding, so it stays a design assumption — but, following add-basket's precedent (its 1.8 'Error state when the basket cannot be loaded' test with no scenario), task 1.10 adds one extra page test 'Failed panel load' so the branch is not shipped untested. AdminPage.test.tsx therefore holds 15 tests (14 scenarios + 1).

Finding 2 applied with the structural option: D9 and task 6.1 type the helper as request<T>(method, path, { schema?: { parse(input: unknown): T }; body? }) and say explicitly that apps/web never imports zod and the loop agent must not pnpm add zod. Verified before editing: no node_modules/zod under apps/web/ or the repo root (zod is in packages/shared/node_modules only). A risk entry records the (theoretical) loss of nominal typing. The re-export alternative was not chosen because it would touch packages/shared for a type the client does not need.

Finding 3 applied, but to the rule add-basket actually landed rather than the critique's literal suggestion: while this revision ran, add-basket's review group 8 was ticked [x] on disk (then the change was archived — spec:check now reports archived: 2). Its basket-web spec now says 'percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent except the `:` between shop key and source id' and its scenario pins /api/basket/items/osio:a%23b; client.ts has itemPath = encodeURIComponent(productId).replaceAll('%3A', ':'). Pinning /api/admin/products/osio%3A6abcf.../visibility as the critique wrote (based on the older wording) would have made the admin client contradict the rule the shared helper's other callers now follow — the exact inconsistency the finding objects to. So: D9 extracts that encoder into one private encodeProductId(id) used by itemPath and setProductVisibility; the admin-web client requirement states the same rule; the existing client scenario keeps the literal path /api/admin/products/osio:6abcf192b7db2532803d266d/visibility; a new scenario 'Product id is URL-encoded in the visibility path' (setProductVisibility('osio:a#b', true) → /api/admin/products/osio:a%23b/visibility) proves the encoding, mirroring add-basket's scenario; task 1.8 is now three client tests. The admin-settings API scenarios are unchanged (Hono decodes :id), as the finding says.

Finding 4 applied: tasks 1.7 (apps/api/src/lib/admin-auth.test.ts — three login results; apps/api/src/lib/admin.test.ts — seven tests over a stub loadAll + temp settings store: flags/total/visible for null and for an array, first-toggle default array, append beyond ten, idempotent repeat, not-found writes nothing, updateSettings persists before setSource) and 1.11 (apps/web/src/components/AdminLoginForm.test.tsx — submit passes the token, alert text per status incl. a status-less error, alert cleared on next submit; AdminShopSection.test.tsx — four status notes, 'Видимих: N' and the list, no <ul> when empty, onToggle callback with (id, checked)) were added; group 1 renumbered 1.7–1.12 and every cross-reference (5.1, 5.2, 6.1, 6.3, 7.1, smoke-run note) updated; the File layout, D5, D6, D12 and the proposal name the tests. All unit tests reuse the scenarios' exact ids, arrays and texts so they pin no second truth.

To satisfy web.md without a third component test, the separate AdminPanel.tsx was removed from the plan: AdminPage.tsx owns the state and renders the panel markup itself; AdminLoginForm({ onSubmit }) owns its alert state and exports the pure loginAlert(error); AdminShopSection({ shop, products, onToggle }) is presentational. Recorded in D10 (with the alternative), the File layout, task 6.3 and proposal Impact.

Because add-basket's group 8 landed concurrently, routes/basket.test.ts now contains a second full-service-typed catalog literal and a second createApp call (inside 'Non-integer price sums without float noise'); task 5.4 and D8 now name both call sites, the 5.4 grep window was widened to 8 lines for the multi-line call, and precondition 1.1 additionally checks for itemPath, lib/basket.test.ts and BasketLine.test.tsx (ten patterns) so D9's reuse of the encoder cannot start on a tree without it. The design Context records the group-8 state.
